description: Connect Codex to AuraCite AI Visibility Intelligence, Google Search Console evidence, project operations, approved writes, spend-capped workflows, and enterprise-safe agent operating rules.

interface.shortDescription: Operate AuraCite from Codex with scoped reads, approved writes, and spend-capped workflows.
interface.longDescription: AuraCite Agent Hub connects Codex to AuraCite's AI Visibility Intelligence, Google Search Console evidence, project configuration, Action Center, project memory, and evidence-backed operating rules. It uses the hosted OAuth-capable MCP JSON-RPC endpoint at https://auracite.de/mcp/rpc by default, so users sign in to AuraCite and approve scoped access instead of pasting API keys. Read and draft tools cover visibility, GSC, Intelligence, Action Center, memory, and project context. With mcp:write, Codex can request approval-gated project, brand, prompt, memory, Action Center, and stored-rescore writes; the first call creates a tenant/project/API-key-bound pending approval, and the approved retry is one-use and idempotent. With mcp:spend, Codex can request provider scans or AI prompt generation with hard credit/USD caps and CostGuard. Admin, destructive, credit-grant, demo-user, publishing, and raw Vault-file writes remain blocked.
defaultPrompt: Compare my AI visibility evidence with Google Search Console performance.
Review AuraCite Intelligence opportunities and prepare a gated Action Center handoff draft.
Build an AuraCite Context Pack from Intelligence evidence and project memory.
